content_sections.heading: JJB Tenkasi Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and 1 for Office Assistant.

content_sections.heading: JJB Tenkasi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk: Pass in (X) 10th Standard or its equivalent. Preference will be given to candidates who have a typing certificate (Tamil & English) and proficiency in computers. Office Assistant: Pass in (VIII) 8th Standard or its equivalent.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JJB Tenkasi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JJB Tenkasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the JJB Tenkasi Recruitment 2026 is 05 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk and Office Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies. One vacancy is for the Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk post and another for the Office Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 8th Standard or its equivalent to be eligible for the Office Assistant position.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for JJB Tenkasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years for all the posts announced by JJB Tenkasi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The Junior Assistant-cum-Record Clerk will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Office Assistant will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 13,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JJB Tenkasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will be conducted by the District Selection Committee. Further details about the stages of selection are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for JJB Tenkasi Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can typically be downloaded from the official website of the Juvenile Justice Board Tenkasi or through the links provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
